native.ss_point_offset: Actual point offset in model payload.

native.ss_order_verified: Actual ordered points before groups, repeat instances consecutive.
native.ss_atomic: Actual sync group accessed wholly and atomically.
native.ss_count_static: Actual referenced count point is static.

native.ss_sf_static: Actual scale-factor point never changes over operation.
native.ss_sf_type_verified: Actual referenced scale-factor point is sunssf.
native.ss_symbols_verified: Actual enum value or bit position belongs to this point’s definition.
native.ss_write_success: Actual successful information write; not functional acceptance.
native.ss_readback_match: Actual read-after-write reflects last successful request.
native.ss_data_accepted: Actual consuming behavior and timing independently accepted.
native.ss_lower_binding_verified: Actual separate selected Modbus/TCP/serial/PHY configuration verified.
native.ss_codec_verified: Actual complete model schema/sentinel/encoding decoding verified.
native.ss_tls12_supported: Actual mandatory TLS1.2 support independent of selected1.3.
native.ss_mutual_tls: Actual both client/server authenticated during handshake.
native.ss_client_certificate: Actual client provided a validated certificate.
native.ss_fatal_terminated: Actual missing client certificate causes fatal termination.
native.ss_resume_after_fatal: Actual forbidden resume after fatal alert.

native.ss_iana_allowed: Actual IANA suite status verified for negotiated cipher.
native.ss_certificate_compatible: Actual suite compatible with X509v3 credential key/signature.
native.ss_disable_discouraged: Actual ability to disable IANA-discouraged suites.
native.ss_mandatory_roles: Actual all four mandatory roles supported.
native.ss_rights_configurable: Actual vendor supplied configurable point-level roles-to-rights database.
native.ss_role_map_verified: Actual required SunSpec role map revision verified, no broad role-only write approval.
native.ss_authorized: Actual all requested points allowed by current client role.
native.ss_public_network: Actual communications routed over a public network.
native.ss_ca_signed: Actual certificate CA-signed, mandatory on public network per section5.4.
native.ss_trust_verified: Actual full validated trusted chain/current lifecycle.
native.ss_p256_supported: Actual required ECCP256 support, not a guessed negotiated key.
native.ss_compression_null: Actual NULL TLS compression; distinct forbidden NULL crypto.
native.ss_weak_crypto: Actual MD5/SHA1 HMAC or NULL crypto/forbiddenSHA1PRF selected.
native.ss_model_source: Actual exact approved/vendor model definition and revision.
native.ss_registered_source: Actual separately registered edition schema; current reviewed bounds do not certify it.
native.ss_binding_source: Actual selected serial/TCP/security canonical endpoints and separate lower-layer profile.
native.ss_point_id: Actual unique alphanumeric or underscore ID in containing group.
native.ss_raw_hex: Actual exact encoded whole point hex, preserves uint64/sentinels without floating-point loss.
native.ss_rights_source: Actual vendor point-rights database and SunSpec role-map revision.
native.ss_role_encoding: Actual ASN1UTF8String encoding of one role.
native.payload_bytes: Actual application/model data bytes, independent of contiguousmodelregisterlength and per-ModbusfunctionPDU253-byte limit. No generic8byte/65535byte stream/modelcap.
